args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
- `round_money` in `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but FIN-212 (and the function's own docstring) requires banker's rounding.
- Switched to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so `2.665` rounds to `2.66` while `2.675` rounds to `2.68`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on `08d3cd5986` passed (`tests/test_money.py` green).

This unblocks today's release; the nightly build was failing on this test.
